description: Every data-centre project our pipeline tracker lists in one European market, latest stage first: name, stage, stated MW, the date it was last checked and its page. Needs a personal DC Blueprint key (Authorization: Bearer) from an account with a DC Blueprint licence or trial. The market costs 1 credit; the same list again in the calendar month costs nothing. A list longer than 25 projects comes in pages (the "page" argument). The market overview gives the first three projects of a market to everyone. Metros: London, Frankfurt, Paris, Amsterdam, Dublin, Milan, Madrid, Central Scotland, Zaragoza, Zurich, Helsinki, Athens, Berlin, Lille, Lyon, Rhineland, Rome, Warsaw, Barcelona, Lisbon, Stockholm, Bristol, Copenhagen, Oslo. Countries: United Kingdom, Germany, Italy, Spain, France, Finland, Netherlands, Norway, Ireland, Poland, Sweden, Greece, Switzerland, Denmark, Portugal, Belgium, Czechia, Romania, Croatia, Estonia, Austria, Lithuania, Hungary, Latvia.

market.description: A country or metro name, e.g. "Frankfurt", "Ireland", "the Netherlands".

page.description: Optional: the page of 25 projects, from 1.
